fields.actor: A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, passed any of the following
fields.summary: A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of 14 CFR § 61.56, passed a pilot proficiency check or practical test conducted by an examiner, an approved pilot check airman, or a U.S. Armed Force, for a pilot certificate, rating, or operating privilege, need not accomplish the flight review required by this section.
fields.quote:
(d) A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, passed any of the following need not accomplish the flight review required by this section:

(1) A pilot proficiency check or practical test conducted by an examiner, an approved pilot check airman, or a U.S. Armed Force, for a pilot certificate, rating, or operating privilege.

fields.actor_quote: A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, passed any of the following
fields.actor: A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, passed any of the following
fields.summary: A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of 14 CFR § 61.56, passed a practical test conducted by an examiner for the issuance of a flight instructor certificate, an additional rating on a flight instructor certificate, meeting recent experience requirements for a flight instructor certificate in accordance with § 61.197(b)(1), or the reinstatement of flight instructor privileges in accordance with § 61.199(b)(2), need not accomplish the flight review required by this section.
fields.quote:
(d) A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, passed any of the following need not accomplish the flight review required by this section:

(1) A pilot proficiency check or practical test conducted by an examiner, an approved pilot check airman, or a U.S. Armed Force, for a pilot certificate, rating, or operating privilege.

(2) A practical test conducted by an examiner for one of the following:

(i) The issuance of a flight instructor certificate,

(ii) An additional rating on a flight instructor certificate,

(iii) To meet the recent experience requirements for a flight instructor certificate in accordance with § 61.197(b)(1); or

(iv) The reinstatement of flight instructor privileges in accordance with § 61.199(b)(2).

fields.actor_quote: A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, satisfactorily accomplished one or more phases of an FAA-sponsored pilot proficiency program
fields.actor: A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, satisfactorily accomplished one or more phases of an FAA-sponsored pilot proficiency program
fields.summary: A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of 14 CFR § 61.56, satisfactorily accomplished one or more phases of an FAA-sponsored pilot proficiency program need not accomplish the flight review required by this section.
fields.quote: (e) A person who has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, satisfactorily accomplished one or more phases of an FAA-sponsored pilot proficiency program need not accomplish the flight review required by this section.

fields.actor_quote: A person who holds a flight instructor certificate
fields.actor: A person who holds a flight instructor certificate
fields.summary: A person who holds a flight instructor certificate need not accomplish the one hour of ground training specified in paragraph (a) of 14 CFR § 61.56 if that person has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, satisfactorily completed the recent experience requirements for a flight instructor certificate under § 61.197, or reinstated the person's flight instructor privileges by satisfactorily completing an approved flight instructor refresher course in accordance with § 61.199(a)(1).
fields.quote:
(f) A person who holds a flight instructor certificate need not accomplish the one hour of ground training specified in paragraph (a) of this section if that person has, within the period specified in paragraph (c) of this section, met one of the following requirements—

(1) Satisfactorily completed the recent experience requirements for a flight instructor certificate under § 61.197; or

(2) Reinstated the person's flight instructor privileges by satisfactorily completing an approved flight instructor refresher course in accordance with § 61.199(a)(1).

fields.summary: A student pilot need not accomplish the flight review required by 14 CFR § 61.56 provided the student pilot is undergoing training for a certificate and has a current solo flight endorsement as required under § 61.87 of this part.
fields.quote: (g) A student pilot need not accomplish the flight review required by this section provided the student pilot is undergoing training for a certificate and has a current solo flight endorsement as required under § 61.87 of this part.
